<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:141215253bc37610be82c237f4e45a9d</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>OnChange Certificate Purpose Field</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    var internalandExternalCertPurposeVariables = ['csr'];
    var internalCertPurposeVariables = [];
    var externalCertPurposeVariables = ['validity_period'];
    var fieldsTobeDisabled = ['organization', 'organizational_unit', 'locality', 'province', 'country', 'email', 'subject_common_name', 'subject_alternative_name'];
    var generateCSR = g_form.getValue('want_to_generate_csr');
    if (newValue) {
        //Hide/show catalog form fields based on choosed certificate purpose(internal/external)
        if (generateCSR != "true")
            setDisplayFields(internalandExternalCertPurposeVariables, true);
        setDisplayFields(internalCertPurposeVariables, (newValue == 'internal'));
        setDisplayFields(externalCertPurposeVariables, (newValue == 'external'));

    } else {
        if (generateCSR != "true")
            setDisplayFields(internalandExternalCertPurposeVariables, true);
        setDisplayFields(externalCertPurposeVariables, true);
        setDisplayFields(internalCertPurposeVariables, true);
    }

    //Clear catalog form variables value
    clearCatalogFormVariables(externalCertPurposeVariables);

    function clearCatalogFormVariables(externalCertPurposeVariables) {
        externalCertPurposeVariables.forEach(function(catalogVariable) {
            g_form.setValue(catalogVariable, '');
        });
    }
    if (generateCSR == "true")
        fieldsTobeDisabled = ['csr', 'private_key'];
    setDisabledFields(fieldsTobeDisabled, true);

    function setDisplayFields(formFields, display) {
        formFields.forEach(function(item) {
            if (item == 'csr' || item == 'validity_period') {
                g_form.setMandatory(item, display);
            }
            g_form.setDisplay(item, display);
        });
    }

    function setDisabledFields(formFields, disabled) {
        formFields.forEach(function(item) {
            g_form.setMandatory(item, !disabled);
            g_form.setDisabled(item, disabled);
        });
    }

}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-02-13 17:58:59</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>851255253bc37610be82c237f4e45aa7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OnChange Certificate Purpose Field</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management" source="sn_disco_certmgmt">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_851255253bc37610be82c237f4e45aa7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-02-13 17:58:59</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
